items.title: Suit Mobs
items.creator: Skilendarz
items.description:
When style meets survival! The Suit Mobs skin pack dresses up iconic creatures in slick suits and classy threads. From zombies in tuxedos to endermen in executive wear, these mobs are dressed to impress—whether it’s a boardroom brawl or a red-carpet raid.

- 10 stylish mob skins!
- Perfect for fun and quirky roleplay!
- Get fancy with your favorite mobs!

items.title: Hamsters Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Chubby cheeks and sweet smiles! Pick from a variety of cute hamsters dressed up in everyday fashion for your next playthrough.

+ 12 skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Furniture Builder Add-On 3.0
items.creator: Lofi Girl
items.description:
This FURNITURE Add-On transforms ANY WORLD with functioning and auto-connecting blocks!

- Craftable Furniture BLOCKS
- Fully functional and interactive
- Connected blocks for smooth building
- Multiple styles & variants
- Craftable Houses
items.changelog: Update 3.0: - Umbrellas, Fans, TV screens, Roof edges & much more! - 8 New craftable Structures - Added preview mode to variant selector - Lots of Improvements & Bug Fixes

items.title: Furnaces & Chests Add-On
items.creator: Vatonage
items.description: Enhance your gameplay with upgraded furnaces and chests. Enjoy faster smelting, extra storage and useful features designed to complement and expand the vanilla experience.
items.changelog: Furnaces & Chests v1.1 Universal add-on compatibility: recipes from all add-ons now work in custom furnaces. Fixed Portal Chest bug; breakable only when closed. Break furnaces/chests from 3+ blocks (Survival). UI tweaks, more vanilla fuels/recipes, misc. fixes.

items.title: Biomes Refined Add-On
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Bring your world to life with new trees, flowers, plants and decorative blocks. This add-on adds ice caves, improved beaches, natural ground details and a wide variety of new nature blocks!

+9 New wood sets
+Includes stairs, doors, trapdoors, fences, slabs & more
+Give your world a visual upgrade with Biomes Refined

This item can be applied to any new or existing world!
items.changelog:
Added missing stripped wood and recipes from stripped to planks
Added composter values for most items
Hanging leaves can be placed under every leaf type
Fixed wrong custom fence recipe output always giving oak fences
Improved generation of ice caves
Fixed the piston bug

items.title: Village
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Explore an amazing medieval village full of secrets!

– Find these cool places:
– A big marketplace with traders
– Beautiful town center
– Safe storage rooms everywhere

– Perfect for:
– Playing hide and seek
– Making your own medieval shop
– Meeting with friends
– Having amazing adventures

Get ready for the most fun medieval experience ever!

items.title: Scary Myths with EYstreem
items.creator: Spawnpoint Media
items.description: It's time to scare your friends with these exclusive skins! Transform your Minecraft world into one of YouTuber EYstreem's scary myth adventures. Play as EYstreem.exe, Red Golem, Soul Sandman, Lunar Moon, Corrupt Test Subject, Siren Screamer, Faceless Villager and Entity303.

items.title: Jurassic World Add-On
items.creator: Syclone Studios
items.description: Official Jurassic World dinosaurs can now roam your Minecraft worlds! Build your outpost and set out to find and preserve every dinosaur species. Subdue wild dinosaurs and transport them into high-tech enclosures to extract DNA, observe their behavior, and breed them to prevent their extinction! Includes the latest Rebirth dinosaurs.
items.changelog: Create 35 decoration blocks through the new crafting system in the outpost, including two new fence types with gates to build realistic dinosaur enclosures! This update also allows the Spinosaurus to swim.

items.title: Scary Mobs Add-On 1.0
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Turn your world into a nightmare! Bring Scary Mobs into your own world! Creatures turn into horrifying monsters at night!

+ 25+ Scary Mobs, including the MEGA MUTANT boss!
+ Scary Night VFX!

Note: The Add-On and world are based on the same concept but differ in visuals, effects, and variations. Plus, this version includes mega mobs and can be added to any world!

items.title: Lava Heroes
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Are you ready to go with the flow? The lava flow? Choose from 12 different heroes skins with fiery red, orange, and yellow molten rock textures. Role-play as a magma monster with fabulous flame patterns and evil, scary faces. Gear up and get all fired up!

+ 1 free skin included!

items.title: Weapons And Powers Add-on
items.creator: Ninja Block
items.description:
Unleash unique powers with every weapon! Discover magical, explosive, and elemental abilities in this add-on.

- 60 unique powers
- 20 new weapons
- Custom first and third person animations
- New ores, structures and much more!

APPLY TO ANY WORLD!

items.title: Golden Cheeky
items.creator: Heropixel Games
items.description:
Unleash your inner mischief with the bold and shiny Golden Cheeky crew!
Each skin glows with personality, style, and just the right amount of trouble.

+ Includes 16 unique golden demon skins
+ Perfect for roleplay, PvP, or showing off in multiplayer
+ Packed with attitude, humor, and cheeky charm

by HeroPixels Games

items.title: Horrific Smiles
items.creator: Lore Studios
items.description:
Their smiles are horrific and terrifying, yet they look cool. Are you scared? Don't be – become one of them and frighten your friends!

- 8 Smiling Skins!
- Perfect with friends!
- By Lore Studios

items.title: Morphs++
items.creator: Doctor Benx
items.description:
Are you ready for the ultimate morphing experience? Try out all 100+ morphs and discover their unique special abilities with your friends!

- Designed for hide-and-seek
- 10+ special entities and 90+ vanilla mobs included
- Each morph comes with a unique ability!
- Discover the game from a new perspective with our POV mode

- By DoctorBenx

items.title: CLOWNS
items.creator: Novasoft
items.description: Get ready to terrify your friends with this Creepy Clown Skin Pack! Featuring 5 spine-chilling clown skins, each with eerie makeup and sinister details, this pack is perfect for adding a touch of horror to your adventures.

items.title: STRAWBERRY
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Be bold. Be sweet. Be STRAWBERRY!
Add a fruity twist to your adventures with the STRAWBERRY skin pack!

items.title: Health Bars Pro Add-On
items.creator: Dalibu Studios
items.description:
Health Bars Pro Add-On adds immersion to every fight and takes your battles to the next level! Instantly track mob health bars and get real-time damage feedback.

- Add over +35 unique Health bars
- Endless customizations: style, color, fonts, size, position, and many more!
- Compatible with mobs from other Add-Ons!

items.title: Fairy School
items.creator: A Foxy Toast
items.description:
Transform into a dazzling fairy student and soar through enchanted adventures!
- Stunning, Sparkly Designs
- Cute & Charming Outfits
- Perfect for Magic Lovers and Dreamers

items.title: SB737 Awesome World
items.creator: 5 Frame Studios
items.description:
In SB737's Awesome World, players can explore and find hidden plushies in special locations, adding a fun twist to the adventure!

- SB737 World Famous Awesome World
- Giant theme park

items.title: Highschool Outfits
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Jazz up your style for a new term! These looks are perfect for making a great first impression!

+ 10 Academia Looks
+ FREE Skin: Chris

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Pyramid Parkour
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
You probably WOULDN'T MAKE IT TO THE END... or so the curse goes...Challenge yourself in this massive, pyramid-shaped parkour course!

- Perfect with friends!
- Fun, engaging environments!
- Countless challenges!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Cuddly Animals
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Step into a world of softness and warmth with these Cuddly Animals! This adorable pack features cuddly creatures, including fluffy lambs, calico cats, pygmy hippos, and axolotls. The perfect pack for animal lovers and those who love a kawaii look to their skins!

- 8 Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios
- Artist: Mango Boba

items.title: MEGA MANSION
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Live the luxury life in the MEGA MANSION! Featuring multiple swimming pools, stylish furniture, vehicles, and so much more!
Explore the mansion on your own or invite friends to join the fun in multiplayer.

items.title: RGB Mobs
items.creator: SandBlock Studios
items.description:
Add a burst of color to your world with the RGB Mobs skin pack! These vibrant, animated designs will light up your screen and give your gameplay a bold, energetic twist.

+ 50 skins
+ By SandBlock Studios
